question.text: The typical management fee for a Cat III AIF during commitment period is on:

explanation.text: The Logic: Per Section 3.3.7.2, management fee during commitment period is usually on capital committed (1-2%), later shifting to actual invested capital or AUM. The Trap: Drawn-down-only understates; AUM-only ignores early phase; incentive fees are separate. Cross-Exam Context: Compare to MF TER calculation basis (V-A). Distributor's Pro-Tip: Request a fee timeline showing transition from committed-capital to AUM basis.
